subject.title: feat(android): syntax-highlighted code blocks in chat

question: Should OpenClaw accept this bounded in-repo Android syntax highlighter as the Android slice of the mobile Markdown plan once the release-owned changelog line is removed?
rationale: The patch adds a new visible renderer capability and custom tokenizer maintenance surface under a protected maintainer-labeled PR, so automation can review correctness but should not decide product acceptance.

options.title: Accept Android Slice After Cleanup
options.body: Remove the root changelog entry, keep release-note context in PR metadata or the squash message, and proceed with maintainer review or landing for the Android tokenizer.

options.title: Pause For Shared Renderer Direction
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose whether Android and shared Swift chat should use separate native tokenizers or another shared strategy.

options.title: Decline Custom Tokenizer
options.body: Close or redirect this PR if maintainers do not want to own an in-repo Android tokenizer for chat rendering.

recommendation.title: Accept Android Slice After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the root changelog entry, keep release-note context in PR metadata or the squash message, and proceed with maintainer review or landing for the Android tokenizer.
